title: HitlRequest
description: A human-in-the-loop approval request. Published as a second, independent expression of the isHitlRequest predicate in docs/spec/predicates/v1/: the conformance corpus asserts the two agree, which only means something because they are computed separately. A binding MUST NOT implement the predicate by running this schema.

actionId.description: Identifies the action awaiting approval. Non-empty — which is NOT the blankness rule the manifest registry defines: a single space is a valid value here.

summary.description: Human-facing description of what will happen if approved. Non-empty, on the same terms as actionId.

diff.description: Optional preview of the change. Absent and null are NOT interchangeable: omitting the key is valid, an explicit null is not. A binding whose map lookup returns the same value for a missing key and a null one (Python's dict.get, for instance) will get this wrong.
